meta.name: Select by Box (SAM 3.1)
meta.licenseNote: SAM 3.1 (Meta, 2026-03-27) ships under the SAM License: research and commercial use allowed with no thresholds; military, nuclear, espionage and weapons uses banned; the licence travels with any redistribution; Meta may change the terms. The app ships no weights.
meta.notes: The `sam3.1/segment-point` graph prompted with a box: PrimitiveBoundingBox (stock ComfyUI) feeds SAM3_Detect's bboxes in the request's own pixels (the engine scales the canvas rectangle to the request size), and positive_coords / negative_coords take JSON lists of points inside or outside the object ('[]' when none; checked live 2026-10-16: an empty list is accepted, a negative point trims the mask). No conditioning, so the detector segments the object the box frames (individual_masks true, 2 refinement passes). The prompt placeholder is bound but unused (the backend requires one).
meta.creator: Meta
meta.description: Finds the object a dragged box frames
